correctness.rationale: Exact Euler product R(t) and Legendre valuations imply the required rational comparisons. Above m=2047, splitting by largest prime factor <= or > sqrt(t) and parity of the two large-prime cofactors proves upper bounds (45/34)^2, 675/338, and (9/5)(45/44)^2, all <2 outside prime-pair cofactor patterns. A standalone exact finite certificate exhausts all smaller composite pairs and all 2,047 cumulative factorial transitions, and the only composite one-step doubling. Finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact first two fibers of an established natural prime-gap-related invariant are resolved. The theorem identifies all prime-free two-step doublings as two explicit simultaneous-primality patterns or five sporadic starts and proves a uniform impossibility outside them. It is a complete boundary classification, not an unmotivated finite arithmetic slice; infinitude of prime-pair forms is not asserted.
